paragraphs: Abaye bar Avin and Rabbi Chanina bar Avin. (The Gemara’s “Abaye bar Abba and Rabbi Chanina bar Abaye” is a scribal error, uncorrected in the new Talmud editions.) They studied Terumot at Rabbah’s academy; Rabbah bar Mattanah encountered them, Pesachim 34a. Abaye bar Avin and Rabbi Chanina bar Avin: Eruvin 87b; Berakhot 29b; Shabbat 86, beginning of b. Marimar reported their teaching before Ravina. (Bekhorot 42b: and Rabbi Chanina.) They sat, and Abaye sat with them (chapter Haddar 62a; there, 89a). Abaye told them, “Have you not heard what Rabbi Yitzchak bar Avdimi said?” Likewise Yevamot 119b, and the subject there at 36a. He and Rav Chanina bar Avin would exchange their meals (Megillah 7b). Rashi explains: this one eats with the other on Purim this year, and in the next year his colleague dines with him. (See responsa Zekan Aharon, section 214, which leaves Rashi’s explanation requiring examination.)
